submitted.rationale: I spread the five EQE measurements across the composition line. The highest was 0.0132% at Sb=0.28 (index 10). Values were lower at Sb=0.17 (0.0089%), 0.11 (0.0025%), 0.51 (0.0041%) and 0.76 (0.00006%). This points to a peak somewhere around Sb 0.2–0.35, and index 10 is the best composition I measured.
